data.title: Build a Paragraph About Sharks
data.topic: Sharks and how they live in the ocean
topicSentenceFrames: ___ are fish that live in the ___.
The most important thing to know is that ___.
Have you ever wondered what ___ are?

modelParagraph.topicSentence: Sharks are fish that live in the ocean and breathe with gills.
detailSentences: First, sharks swim very fast to catch their food.
Next, they have strong teeth that help them eat.
For example, a great white shark can hunt fish and other ocean animals.
modelParagraph.concludingSentence: As you can see, sharks are special animals that fit right into their ocean home.
